summary: Tested AirYatra OS Phase 1 - Membership, Corporate, Document Vault backend APIs (14/14 pytest cases passing) and frontend UI (LandingPage Premium Services section, MembershipPage tiers, /corporate protected route). Discovered and fixed 4 blocker bugs in the newly implemented routes (undefined enum references and MongoDB ObjectId leaks in response bodies).

critical.issue: calculate_document_status() referenced undefined name 'DocumentStatus' -> NameError 500 on every upload. Fixed by using DocumentVaultStatus (imported).
Used undefined 'ApprovalStatus.AUTO_APPROVED' in message branch (module imports CorporateApprovalStatus). Fixed by switching to CorporateApprovalStatus.
Returned inserted document containing raw ObjectId `_id` -> FastAPI 500 (ObjectId not iterable). Fixed by popping _id before returning.
Same ObjectId `_id` leak in response body -> 500. Fixed.

action_items: Review the four backend NameError/ObjectId bugs that were fixed by the testing agent; ensure similar patterns aren't repeated in other Phase 1 endpoints (e.g., document version upload, share, folder create also insert docs then return the same dict — currently they don't return the raw doc so are safe, but pattern is fragile).
Corporate route file corporate_routes.py has other endpoints returning inserted docs indirectly via corporate_doc/employee_doc which now pop _id — verify code review OK.
Consider adding a global JSON encoder for ObjectId / centralised response_model to prevent regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: document_vault_routes.py imports DocumentVaultStatus but originally used DocumentStatus - dead symbol usage; add a pyflakes/ruff check to CI.
corporate_routes.py used ApprovalStatus (not imported) — same class of bug; add lint step for undefined names before merge.
Multiple insert_one paths in the new modules mutate the input dict and return it. Adopt a helper that strips _id (or use Pydantic response_models) instead of ad-hoc pop calls.
seed_data_creation: Test corporate accounts prefixed TEST_Corp_* and vault documents named TEST_Document created during pytest runs; not cleaned up (owner IDs are random per-run).
test_credentials: admin@airyatra.com / Admin123! (not required for Phase 1 module APIs — currently unauthenticated)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 module APIs and MembershipPage UI verified. /corporate correctly redirects to /login when unauthenticated. Landing Page Premium Services cards render with data-testids explore-membership-btn, explore-corporate-btn, explore-vault-btn. MembershipPage renders all 4 tier cards with correct pricing (₹25k / ₹75k / ₹2,00,000 / ₹5,00,000). Full CorporateDashboard employee flow (register-corporate-btn), DocumentVault upload UI, and authenticated flows were NOT tested end-to-end via UI — recommend covering in next iteration once auth flows for corporate admin are wired.
rca_of_the_issue: The Phase 1 modules were newly added; two symbols were used without matching import (DocumentStatus, ApprovalStatus) — this is a plain undefined-name defect. Two other endpoints returned MongoDB documents whose _id (ObjectId) FastAPI's default JSON encoder can't serialise, producing 500s. All four defects were within Fix Scope (standard coding bugs / MongoDB _id in response) and have been patched.
